name: Pitikostudio Viral Engagement Toolkit
author: pitikostudio

sections.description:
Pitikostudio Viral Engagement Toolkit adds lightweight engagement features that work with any modern WordPress theme.

Features include:

  • Reaction buttons for single posts.
  • Aggregate post view counts.
  • Hot score ranking based on views, reactions, comments, and post age.
  • Trending posts shortcode.
  • Trending posts widget.
  • Settings to enable or disable automatic reactions and view tracking.

The plugin is standalone and does not require a specific theme.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin folder to /wp-content/plugins/, or install the ZIP from the WordPress admin.
  2. Activate the plugin.
  3. Go to Settings > Pitikostudio Engagement to adjust the options.
  4. Use [pitikostudio_viral_reactions] inside a post, or [pitikostudio_viral_trending limit="5" mode="hot"] in any shortcode area.
sections.faq:
Does this plugin require a Pitikostudio theme?

No. It works with any WordPress theme.

Does the plugin call external services?

No. It does not load remote scripts, fonts, images, APIs, or tracking services.

Does the plugin collect personal data?

The plugin stores aggregate view counts and reaction totals in WordPress post meta. It does not store visitor identifiers in cookies or browser storage, and it does not send data to external servers.
